title: Synonyms and Antonyms
content:
Definition

English: Synonyms are words with similar meanings, while antonyms are words with opposite meanings.
Hindi: Synonyms wo shabd hote hain jinka arth samaan hota hai, jabki antonyms wo shabd hote hain jinka arth vipreet hota hai.

They enrich vocabulary and improve communication by providing variety or contrast.
Ye shabdsampada ko badhate hain aur sanchar ko rochak ya vyaktigat banate hain.

Example: Synonym: Big = Large. Antonym: Big ≠ Small.
Hindi: Synonym: Bada = Vishal. Antonym: Bada ≠ Chhota.

title: Synonyms
content:
Definition

English: Synonyms are words that have the same or nearly the same meaning and can often be used interchangeably in certain contexts.
Hindi: Synonyms wo shabd hote hain jinka arth ek samaan ya lagbhag ek jaisa hota hai aur kayi sandarbhon mein ek doosre ke sthan par prayog kiye ja sakte hain.

Use

Used to avoid repetition, add variety, or clarify meaning.
Dohraav se bachne, vividhta jodne, ya arth spasht karne ke liye.

Example: Happy = Joyful, Cheerful, Delighted.
Hindi: Khush = Prasann, Anandit, Harshit.

title: Antonyms
content:
Definition

English: Antonyms are words that have opposite meanings, used to express contrast.
Hindi: Antonyms wo shabd hote hain jinka arth vipreet hota hai, jo virodh vyakt karne ke liye prayog hote hain.

Use

Used to show contrast, emphasize differences, or clarify meaning.
Virodh dikhane, antar par zor dene, ya arth spasht karne ke liye.

Example: Big ≠ Small, Tiny, Little.
Hindi: Bada ≠ Chhota, Nanha, Thoda.

title: Using Synonyms and Antonyms
content:
Use

English: Synonyms add variety and precision to language, while antonyms highlight contrasts or oppositions.
Hindi: Synonyms bhasha mein vividhta aur spashtata jodte hain, jabki antonyms virodh ya antar ko ujaagar karte hain.

Example: Synonym: She is cheerful today (instead of happy). Antonym: She is sad today (instead of happy).
Hindi: Synonym: Woh aaj prasann hai (khush ke badle). Antonym: Woh aaj udas hai (khush ke vipreet).

title: Context in Synonyms and Antonyms
content:
Explanation

English: Synonyms may have slight differences in meaning depending on context, and antonyms may not always be exact opposites but convey contrast.
Hindi: Synonyms ka arth sandarbh ke anusaar thoda alag ho sakta hai, aur antonyms hamesha poora vipreet nahi hote balki virodh vyakt karte hain.

Example: Synonym: 'Big' and 'huge' differ in intensity (a huge mountain vs. a big house). Antonym: 'Big' vs. 'small' depends on context (a big ant is still small).
Hindi: Synonym: 'Bada' aur 'vishal' mein taakat ka antar hai (vishal parvat banam bada ghar). Antonym: 'Bada' banam 'chhota' sandarbh par nirbhar hai (ek badi cheenti phir bhi chhoti hai).
